CommunityApplications.Profile: DSH（DeepSeek Harness，浏览器里用的开源 AI 编码智能体）在 Unraid 上的 Community Applications 模板：多架构镜像（amd64 / arm64）随上游发版自动重建，内置 bubblewrap 以适配没有 Landlock 的 Unraid 内核，并提供中英文安装文档、沙箱原理说明与从其它镜像迁移的步骤。容器内置 Caddy 反向代理、可选口令门禁与 ALLOWED_CLIENTS 白名单，以 uid 1000 非特权运行。⚠️ 上游处于开发者预览阶段，未来会出现破坏兼容性的变更。 | DSH (DeepSeek Harness), an open-source AI coding agent you drive from the browser, packaged for Unraid: a multi-arch image (amd64 / arm64) rebuilt automatically for each upstream release, with bubblewrap bundled for Unraid kernels that lack Landlock, plus installation documentation in Chinese and English, the sandbox rationale, and a migration guide. Support goes through the Unraid forum thread linked in this profile. The container bundles its reverse proxy, an optional password gate and an ALLOWED_CLIENTS allowlist, and runs unprivileged as uid 1000. ⚠️ Upstream is in developer preview; compatibility-breaking changes are coming. | 支持请走本 profile 中链接的 Unraid 论坛支持帖。
